function o3(e, t) {

  return Object.freeze({
    scale: a,
    rect: Object.freeze({ x: s, y: i, w: o, h: r }),
    worldToDisplay(u, d) {
      return [s + u * a, i + d * a];
    },
    displayToWorld(u, d) {
      return u < s || d < i || u >= s + o || d >= i + r ? null : [(u - s) / a, (d - i) / a];
    },
    tileCenterToDisplay(u, d, p = 0, g = 0) {
      return this.worldToDisplay((u - p) * 16 + 8, (d - g) * 16 + 8);
    }
  });
}
